title: 第114章 白婉婉又要作妖第113章 下不去手
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
“那跟我来。“
江欲站起来，拍了拍衣摆上沾的碎屑，转身朝着院墙旁边那片空地走去。
谢云开跟在后面，和她之间隔了几步的距离。
那片空地是沧溟平时练刀的地方，草地上的草已经被踩得有些平了，边缘处有几棵老树。
江欲走到空地中央停了下来，转过身看着谢云开，目光在他身上上下扫了一圈，然后开口了：“你用灵力试试看，看看现在能运转到什么程度。“
谢云开站在她面前，听话的抬起了右手。
灵力从他掌心涌出的时候比他预想中顺畅了不少，在他手掌上方凝成一道约莫拳头大的光团。
那光团的亮度比他昨天刚恢复灵根时稳定了不少，边缘也不再颤抖了。
他低头看着自己掌心那团正在缓慢流转的光芒，过了好一会儿才开口：“……恢复比我想象中快。“
“那当然，“江欲的声音从他面前传过来，“我说了帮你比你自己慢慢来快很多，你又不信。“
谢云开的耳根又浮起了一层薄薄的红，他握着掌心的光芒没有抬头看她，只是把灵力收了回去，手指在掌心里蜷了蜷又松开。
晚上吃完饭的时候，石桌边的气氛和早上差不多，江寻竹收了碗筷去厨房洗，陆川坐在院子里那片矮墙边上，借着月光在翻一本旧书卷。
沧溟端着茶杯坐在石桌旁边，目光落在桌面边缘那道被刻了不知道多少年的木纹上，像是在走神。
江欲靠在椅背上，正低头看自己指尖，突然感觉到一阵气流的变动，她抬起眼来，看到沧溟已经站到了她面前。
他站起来的时候椅子腿在石板上刮了一声不算太响的轻响，整个人挡在她和院子那扇门之间，一只手搭在石桌边沿，微微弯下腰来。
少年的目光落在她的脸上，声音比平时低了半度，带着一股他压了半天终于没压住的东西。
“主上，你最近总是在和他们……双修。“
他顿了一下，像是在找接下来的词，耳根已经浮起了一层薄薄的粉色，可他没有移开目光，就那么看着她。
“都没轮到过我。“
江欲靠在椅背上仰头看着他，看他那副红着耳朵一本正经地说出这段话来的模样，嘴角弯了一下。

“因为你暂时还不太行。”
这话说完旁边传来一声脆响。
谢云开手里的碗突然手滑掉到了桌上，发出了一声不大不小的清脆声响。
他的动作停了一瞬，然后他低下头去，耳根到脖颈的地方正在以一种肉眼可见的速度变色，像是在努力装作自己什么都没有听到。
江欲的目光从谢云开那边收回来，重新落在沧溟那张还在等答案的脸上，正要开口说点什么，院墙外面传来了脚步声。
那脚步声从山路上来，走到院门口便放慢了，然后是一阵气喘吁吁的敲门声，节奏又急又短，像是跑了一路过来的。
沧溟的话被打断了，他的手还搭在石桌边沿没有收回去。
content_en:
"Then follow me."
Jiang Yu stood up, patted the debris on his clothes, turned around and walked towards the open space next to the courtyard wall.
Xie Yunkai followed, a few steps away from her.
The open space was where Cangming usually practiced his sword. The grass on the grass had been trampled somewhat flat, and there were a few old trees on the edge.
Jiang Yu walked to the middle of the open space and stopped, turned around and looked at Xie Yunkai, his eyes swept up and down his body, and then said: "Try using your spiritual power to see how far it can operate now."
Xie Yunkai stood in front of her and raised his right hand obediently.
The spiritual energy poured out from his palm much more smoothly than he expected, forming a ball of light about the size of his fist above his palm.
The brightness of the light group was much more stable than when he had just recovered his spiritual roots yesterday, and the edges no longer trembled.
He looked down at the slowly flowing light in his palm, and after a while he spoke: "...The recovery is faster than I thought."
"Of course," Jiang Yu's voice came from in front of him, "I said that helping you would be much faster than doing it yourself, but you don't believe it."
A thin layer of red appeared on Xie Yunkai's ears again. He held the light in his palm without raising his head to look at her. He just withdrew his spiritual power and curled and loosened his fingers in his palm.
After dinner in the evening, the atmosphere at the stone table was similar to that in the morning. Jiang Xunzhu put away the dishes and went to the kitchen to wash them. Lu Chuan sat by the low wall in the yard, reading an old book by the moonlight.
Cangming was sitting next to the stone table with a teacup in his hand. His eyes fell on the wood grain that had been carved for who knows how many years on the edge of the table, as if he was distracted.
Jiang Yu leaned on the back of the chair and was looking down at her fingertips. Suddenly she felt a change in the air flow. She raised her eyes and saw that Cangming was already standing in front of her.
When he stood up, the legs of his chair scraped a not too loud sound on the stone slab. He stood between her and the door to the courtyard, one hand resting on the edge of the stone table, and he bent down slightly.
The young man's eyes fell on her face, and his voice was half a degree lower than usual, carrying something that he had suppressed for a long time and finally managed to suppress.
"Lord, you have been practicing with them... lately."
He paused for a moment, as if he was looking for the next words, and a thin layer of pink appeared at the base of his ears, but he did not look away, just looking at her.
"It's never been my turn."
Jiang Yu leaned on the back of the chair and looked up at him. He looked at him with red ears and said this seriously, and the corners of his mouth curled up.
"Because you're not very good at the moment."
After saying this, there was a crisp sound next to him.
The bowl in Xie Yunkai's hand suddenly slipped and fell to the table, making a small crisp sound.
His movement paused for a moment, and then he lowered his head. The area from his ears to his neck was changing color at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if he was trying to pretend that he didn't hear anything.
Jiang Yu's eyes retracted from Xie Yunkai and fell back on Cangming's face, which was still waiting for an answer. Just as he was about to say something, footsteps came from outside the courtyard wall.
The footsteps came from the mountain road and slowed down when they reached the door of the courtyard. Then there was a breathless knock on the door. The rhythm was quick and short, as if they had run all the way here.
Cangming's words were interrupted, and his hand was still resting on the edge of the stone table.
